review.tagline: Next.js 16 starter with Clerk auth, Drizzle ORM, Tailwind 4 and tooling
review.summary: A clone-and-edit Next.js App Router starter in TypeScript with Tailwind CSS 4, Clerk authentication, and Drizzle ORM on PostgreSQL (PGlite locally, Neon suggested for production). It also wires in next-intl i18n, Vitest, Playwright, Storybook, Sentry, LogTape and Arcjet. It includes no AI features beyond agent instruction files and CodeRabbit review.
review.audience: Developers starting a Next.js app with auth, database and tooling set up
strengths: Runs locally with embedded PGlite database, no Docker or extra setup
Broad dev tooling preconfigured: Vitest, Playwright, Storybook, Commitlint, Knip, i18n-check
Drizzle ORM supports PostgreSQL, SQLite and MySQL, with migration scripts
Includes instruction files for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and Copilot
weaknesses: Auth depends on a hosted Clerk account and API keys
No billing; Stripe, teams, RBAC and shadcn UI are in the paid Pro kit
No built-in AI features such as chat or model calls
Many sponsor-linked services (Sentry, Arcjet, Crowdin, Better Stack) to configure or strip out
needs: Needs Node.js 24+, npm, Clerk, PostgreSQL (PGlite locally, Neon optional), Sentry, Crowdin, Arcjet
